### cloudflareAccess()

```ts
function cloudflareAccess(options): AuthAdapter;
```

Verify a Cloudflare Access application token and return its issuer-scoped
identity. The registry alone maps that identity to a member: an Access user with
no explicit binding is refused by the kit, and nothing is created here.

Precedence: any `Authorization` header or Oyster owner-key cookie is an explicit
Oyster credential, so this adapter passes and the key adapters decide. Register
it after the key adapters and before any terminal adapter. Only the
`Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion` header is read, as Cloudflare recommends.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                  |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `options` | [`CloudflareAccessOptions`](#cloudflareaccessoptions) |

#### Returns

[`AuthAdapter`](../tenancy.md#authadapter)
